# Upstream notice supplement

`abstract-logging@2.0.1` declares MIT in its package metadata and links to
http://jsumners.mit-license.org/ in its Readme.md, but its npm distribution
does not include a separate licence file. `abstract-logging-MIT.html` is the
author's HTTPS licence page retrieved on 2026-10-17. It is preserved verbatim,
including its copyright and permission text, to accompany redistribution.
